name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 22 – Am 110
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 22a. Notes that the protection of the Union’s external land and maritime borders against illegal crossings and hybrid threats, including instrumentalised migration, requires adequate border infrastructure; calls on the Commission to ensure that the Border Management and Visa Instrument and other relevant Union instruments can support, upon request by the Member States concerned, physical border protection infrastructure, including barriers, alongside surveillance and monitoring systems;
